## Gatelark Streets — X petition campaign recap (24 Jun – 4 Jul 2027, BST)

**One thing first:** Post 2201102897773338130 ("Help us call for 20 mph limits…") could not be found on the account — it isn't a published, scheduled or draft post — so only the other three approved posts ran. No new creatives were written.

**Setup:** one campaign ("Gatelark Streets — School Streets Petition"), three line items, website-conversions goal optimised to the "Petition signed" pixel, UK-only location targeting, age 18+ (`AGE_OVER_18`) to match the participation policy, X political-campaigning authorisation used as approved. Budgets were line-item level drawing on the single $450 fund.

**Results (all three line items, full flight):**

| Line item / post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Sign-ups ("Petition signed") |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A — 2201284091706019029 ("closes 4 July") | $29.00 | 20,772 | 6 | 2 |
| B — 2201465285639200080 ("Free to sign") | $206.06 | 176,075 | 88 | 16 |
| C — 2201646479570704685 ("school-gate chatter") | $205.97 | 144,801 | 130 | 12 |
| **Total** | **$441.03** | **341,648** | **224** | **30** |

**What I did along the way:** after ~2 days, post A was under-performing (5 clicks, 1 sign-up), so I paused it on 26 June and moved budget to B and C. In doing so I raised B/C to $22.50/day each, which spent faster than planned — by 30 June ~$271 was gone, so I trimmed B/C to $18/day to stay inside $450. Final spend $441.03, within budget. Line items' end times (4 July) have passed; nothing is left serving.

**Caveats / notes:**
- Sign-up counts are the pixel's reported "Petition signed" conversions (post-engagement + post-view), not independently verified signatures; post-view conversions are included.
- Post A's low numbers may partly reflect its shorter run (paused 26 Jun).
- I did not and cannot verify that signers are UK residents 18+ — that's enforced by the landing page, not the ad targeting beyond age/geo.
- One eligible post (2201102897773338130) was unusable as noted above; worth checking why it's missing from the account.
